# oddsUp

> oddsUp is a web application for monitoring Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets and receiving Telegram alerts when market probabilities cross user-defined thresholds.

Canonical site: https://oddsup.xyz/

## Public pages

- Homepage: https://oddsup.xyz/
- About oddsUp: https://oddsup.xyz/about
- HIP-4 Movers: https://oddsup.xyz/movers

## Product behavior

- Browse supported Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets after signing in.
- Discover active HIP-4 markets ranked by public probability movement.
- Create one-shot probability threshold alerts.
- Receive triggered alerts through a connected Telegram account.

Authenticated account pages, user alerts, settings, and internal APIs are private and are not intended for indexing.
